rules.statement: an atomic inline appends U+FFFC to text_content, which the line-break tables read on both sides

<wbr> appends an opaque U+200B flow-control item: a break opportunity that produces no fragment item
an atomic inline is added whole at its margin box width
an open tag of a span that creates a box fragment adds the span's inline-start margin, border and padding to the position and makes the line create a line box
a close tag adds the span's inline-end margin, border and padding
each line's available width is its layout opportunity between floats, line_right_offset − line_left_offset, with the content width and each float edge truncated to LayoutUnits separately
a line that overflows a layout opportunity narrower than the container, in a block that wraps, is laid out again in the next opportunity
white-space, word-break, overflow-wrap and line-break come from the current item's style at every block-style site, not from the block's
text-indent starts the position of the first formatted line, tracked by kIsPastFirstFormattedLine in the break token
a wrapping span opened inside a nowrap context recomputes the break opportunity after the text before it
ApplyTextAlign moves every item by the alignment offset, and justify distributes the free space
a span that creates a box fragment gets an inline-box item per line, with its start edge on its first line and its end edge on its last
NeedsAccurateEndPosition is true for end, center, justify, left in RTL and right in LTR; a line ending at a space is then reshaped at its end
a shaping group ends at a tag with a nonzero margin, border or padding on that side, or with vertical-align other than baseline
inline margins, borders and padding become LayoutUnits through ComputeLineMarginsForSelf, ComputeLineBorders and ComputeLinePadding, border widths after the style system's snapping
tab stops count from the position plus ComputeFloatOffset, the line's float offset
an atomic inline box is a soft wrap opportunity on both sides, like an ideograph
a soft wrap opportunity between two text items follows the white-space of their nearest common ancestor
which line builder runs is decided over every box's style: the simple builder refuses justify and decorated inline boxes
makes a hard line break item
<wbr> makes a word break opportunity item
an atomic inline takes its margin box width on the line
a candidate whose minimum width doesn't fit while the line is constrained by a float wraps with nothing placed, and the next line's top is the float's bottom
an inline box with margin, border or padding counts as line content
the line rect is narrowed by the floats intersecting the line's initial height, by half-open intersection, so a zero-width float narrows nothing
inline box start and end items are margin + border + padding wide
spans that cross a line start are opened again on the next line
text-indent is a start margin of the first formatted line's rect
content starts inside the line rect at horizontalAlignmentOffset
justification expands boxes over the closed run list
declared margins, borders and padding become BoxGeometry lengths, border widths after the style system's snapping
each block-style read takes the style the source reads: the root's, the item's, the parent's or the nearest common ancestor's
tab stops read m_lineContentEdgeOffset, how far floats and text-indent moved the line start
a span opens per-span line data with its own available end
a BRFrame is always placed and ends the line
a non-text frame such as an atomic inline records an optional break after it
every continuation of a span takes the span's end border and padding off the available end, on every line, and its start edge only without a previous continuation
a span's end margin applies to its last continuation only
a line begins at its band's float available space: its inline start and size
with floats in the band the line start is a soft break, and a first frame that doesn't fit breaks before instead of being placed
inside a nowrap span every frame fits
a break before the first frame in a band with floats redoes the line in the next band
text-indent is added to the root span's position on the block's first line
trimming trailing white space at a line end recurses into spans
a WBRFrame gives a break opportunity without a character
